_comment: #508. The only non-residential palette, and the only one whose Base is darker than its trim:
SoMa is unpainted brick, board-formed concrete and cement plaster, so the wall field runs red
brick, warm grey concrete, buff and a cool grey. Nothing here is a paint colour - these are
material colours, which is the whole difference between this district and the belt.
Accent1 and Accent2 therefore go DOWN, not up: a mortar/limestone grey-brown for the sill and
lintel courses, so trim reads as a change of material rather than a coat of paint. Metal is the
load-bearing role here - dark steel sash and rollup doors are what soma_industrial and
soma_loft_commercial are made of - so it is the darkest, coolest Metal in the library.
Sign is a painted-brick ghost-sign red.
Authored, not verified in an Editor.
